options.content:
**How to read this dashboard**

- **Escaped Defect Rate** counts issues whose normalized `type` is `BUG`/`INCIDENT`, or whose `original_type` contains `bug`, `defect`, or `incident`. The SQL does not inspect issue labels, so labels alone do not qualify; projects without matching type data can show zero even when defects exist. Check the "Defect-Rate Coverage by Project" table below before interpreting the rate.
- **Contributors** is deduplicated by `accounts.full_name` (falling back to the PR author name when no account matches), because one engineer can accumulate several `accounts` rows as their git client runs from different machines and IPs. This narrows the overcount but doesn't fully collapse it — see the "Distinct-Account Sanity Check" table below for the residual gap.
- **AI Spend and the AI side of Cost per Merged PR are Claude Code OTel-only** (`ai_model_usages`) and use both the Project and Claude Code OTel Teams filters. The PR denominator uses the Project filter only; the team filter does not narrow PRs.
- **Developer filter:** AI Spend matches the developer's OTel email; PR and contributor figures match the PR author's GitHub account, using the account GitHub links to that email through the developer's commits. Developers marked *no GitHub link* have no PR figures. Tasks Done, Tasks per Contributor, Escaped Defect Rate, Defect-Rate Coverage and the weekly Tasks Done and Escaped Defects columns are project-wide and ignore the Developer filter. An email that GitHub links to more than one account counts as *no GitHub link*. Account IDs are assumed to come from a single GitHub host (github.com).

panels.description: Total estimated AI spend, Claude Code OTel-only, scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s) (`SUM(ai_model_usages.estimated_cost_usd)`).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(estimated_cost_usd) AS "AI Spend"
FROM ai_model_usages
WHERE source_connection_id IN (
  SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
  INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
  WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND (c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND c.team_slug IN (SELECT c_g.team_slug FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
)
AND $__timeFilter(date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer_emails) OR user_email IN ($developer_emails))

panels.title: AI Spend

panels.description: Merged pull requests, scoped to the selected project(s).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "PRs Merged"
FROM project_pr_metrics ppm
JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
WHERE ppm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR (pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) IN ($developer)))

panels.title: PRs Merged

panels.description: Counts resolved domain issues linked to boards in the selected project(s), where `type` is not BUG/INCIDENT/EPIC and `original_type` does not contain bug/defect/incident/epic. This query does not inspect labels, and SQL's `type NOT IN` also excludes rows with a NULL type. It uses `resolution_date` as the completion signal rather than tracker-specific status strings; the result therefore includes any remaining issue types, not only Jira Tasks/Sub-tasks. Ignores the Developer filter: most tasks come from Jira, whose assignees rarely expose an email that can be matched to a developer.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Tasks Done"
FROM issues i
JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = bi.board_id AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
WHERE pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
  AND i.type NOT IN ('BUG','INCIDENT','EPIC') AND LOWER(COALESCE(i.original_type,'')) NOT REGEXP 'bug|defect|incident|epic'
  AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)

panels.title: Tasks Done (project-wide)

panels.description: Distinct pull request authors, scoped to the selected project(s) and deduplicated by `accounts.full_name` (falling back to the PR author name when no account matches). This narrows but doesn't fully eliminate the overcount from fragmented accounts — see the Distinct-Account Sanity Check table below.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name,''), pr.author_name)) AS "Contributors"
FROM project_pr_metrics ppm
JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id
WHERE ppm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR (pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) IN ($developer)))

panels.title: Contributors

panels.description: PRs Merged ÷ Contributors, both scoped to the selected project(s).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(prs.n / NULLIF(c.n,0), 1) AS "PRs per Contributor"
FROM
  (SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id=ppm.id WHERE ppm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR (pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) IN ($developer)))) prs,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name,''), pr.author_name)) n FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id=ppm.id LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id=pr.author_id WHERE ppm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR (pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) IN ($developer)))) c

panels.title: PRs per Contributor

panels.description: Resolved non-defect, non-epic issues per distinct PR author: the numerator uses the selected project(s)' board-linked issues and `resolution_date`, while the denominator uses merged-PR contributors. Issues are excluded by normalized `type` and `original_type` text (not labels); NULL `type` rows are excluded by SQL. Since these are different populations, treat the ratio as directional. Ignores the Developer filter on both sides, because tasks cannot be attributed to a developer.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(t.n / NULLIF(c.n,0), 1) AS "Tasks per Contributor"
FROM
  (SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM issues i JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id=i.id JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id=bi.board_id AND pm.`table`='boards' WHERE pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND i.type NOT IN ('BUG','INCIDENT','EPIC') AND LOWER(COALESCE(i.original_type,'')) NOT REGEXP 'bug|defect|incident|epic' AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)) t,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name,''), pr.author_name)) n FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id=ppm.id LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id=pr.author_id WHERE ppm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)) c

panels.title: Tasks per Contributor (project-wide)

panels.description: Counts distinct board-linked issues whose normalized `type` is BUG/INCIDENT or whose `original_type` contains bug/defect/incident, created within 14 days after a successful deployment whose environment contains `prod` for the same project. The count is divided by all PRs merged in the selected time range for the selected project(s), then multiplied by 100; the denominator is not limited to PRs merged during each deployment's 14-day window. Labels are not queried, so label-only defects are not counted. Ignores the Developer filter on both sides, because escaped defects cannot be attributed to a single developer.

targets.rawSql:
WITH prod_deploys AS (
  SELECT pm.project_name, cdc.finished_date
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits cdc
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = cdc.cicd_scope_id AND pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
  WHERE pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND LOWER(cdc.environment) LIKE '%prod%' AND cdc.result = 'SUCCESS' AND $__timeFilter(cdc.finished_date)
),
defects AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.id
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = bi.board_id AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
  JOIN prod_deploys pd ON pd.project_name = pm.project_name
    AND i.created_date BETWEEN pd.finished_date AND DATE_ADD(pd.finished_date, INTERVAL 14 DAY)
  WHERE pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND (i.type IN ('BUG','INCIDENT') OR LOWER(COALESCE(i.original_type,'')) REGEXP 'bug|defect|incident') AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
),
prs AS (
  SELECT pr.id FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
  WHERE ppm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)
)
SELECT ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM defects) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prs), 0), 2) AS "Escaped Defect Rate (per 100 PRs)"

panels.title: Escaped Defect Rate (project-wide)

panels.description: AI Spend ÷ PRs Merged, both scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s) — Claude Code OTel spend now carries a real project association, so both sides move together.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(spend.cost / NULLIF(prs.n, 0), 2) AS "Cost per Merged PR"
FROM
  (SELECT SUM(estimated_cost_usd) AS cost FROM ai_model_usages
   WHERE source_connection_id IN (
     SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
     INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
     WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND (c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND c.team_slug IN (SELECT c_g.team_slug FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
   )
   AND $__timeFilter(date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer_emails) OR user_email IN ($developer_emails))) spend,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
   WHERE ppm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR (pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) IN ($developer)))) prs

panels.title: Cost per Merged PR

panels.description: Purple bars: Claude Code OTel cost, left USD axis. Neutral bars: merged PRs, right count axis. Different scales: compare each colour across weeks, not bar heights against each other. Completed weeks only; weeks begin Monday, and weeks with no data show as zero. Weeks before Claude Code OTel collection started show no AI bars and a per-PR ratio of 0: that means no data, not no usage. Hover for AI cost per merged PR (left out when no PRs merged) and its change from the previous week. AI cost uses the Project and OTel Teams filters; merged PRs use Project only, so selecting a team narrows only the AI bars. Both sides follow the Developer filter.

matcher.options: AI cost per merged PR · WoW change

targets.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE weekly_prs AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.merged_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.merged_date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS n
  FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
  WHERE ppm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR (pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) IN ($developer)))
  GROUP BY 1
),
weekly_spend AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, SUM(estimated_cost_usd) AS v
  FROM ai_model_usages
  WHERE source_connection_id IN (
    SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
    INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
    WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND (c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND c.team_slug IN (SELECT c_g.team_slug FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer_emails) OR user_email IN ($developer_emails))
  GROUP BY 1
),
wk AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) AS d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM wk WHERE DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) < $__timeTo()
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS week FROM wk
  WHERE TIMESTAMP(d) >= $__timeFrom() AND TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY)) <= DATE_ADD($__timeTo(), INTERVAL 1 SECOND)
),
r AS (
  SELECT w.week, COALESCE(a.v, 0) AS ai, COALESCE(p.n, 0) AS prs, COALESCE(a.v, 0) / NULLIF(p.n, 0) AS ratio
  FROM weeks w
  LEFT JOIN weekly_spend a ON a.week = w.week
  LEFT JOIN weekly_prs p ON p.week = w.week
)
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.week, '%b %e') AS "Week",
  ROUND(ratio, 2) AS "AI cost per merged PR",
  ROUND(ai, 2) AS "AI cost",
  prs AS "PRs merged",
  ROUND(100 * (ratio / NULLIF(LAG(ratio) OVER (ORDER BY r.week), 0) - 1), 1) AS "AI cost per merged PR · WoW change"
FROM r
ORDER BY r.week

panels.title: AI Cost and PRs Merged (Weekly)

panels.description: Weekly totals for Claude Code OTel estimated cost, merged PRs, resolved non-defect/non-epic issues, distinct name-deduplicated PR authors, and classified issues opened within 14 days after successful production deployments. Cost uses the selected Project and OTel Teams; delivery metrics use Project only. Issue classification is based on `type`/`original_type`, not labels. Each cell shows the raw weekly value plus its change from the previous week; an upward change in escaped defects is adverse, while the arrows are not metric-aware. Weeks begin Monday, and weeks with no data show as zero. The Developer filter applies to the AI Cost, PRs Merged and Contributors columns; Tasks Done and Escaped Defects stay project-wide.

targets.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE weekly_cost AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, SUM(estimated_cost_usd) AS v
  FROM ai_model_usages
  WHERE source_connection_id IN (
    SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
    INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
    WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND (c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND c.team_slug IN (SELECT c_g.team_slug FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer_emails) OR user_email IN ($developer_emails))
  GROUP BY 1
),
weekly_prs AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.merged_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.merged_date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS v
  FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
  WHERE ppm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR (pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) IN ($developer))) GROUP BY 1
),
weekly_tasks AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(i.resolution_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(i.resolution_date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, COUNT(*) AS v
  FROM issues i JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = bi.board_id AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
  WHERE pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND i.type NOT IN ('BUG','INCIDENT','EPIC') AND LOWER(COALESCE(i.original_type,'')) NOT REGEXP 'bug|defect|incident|epic' AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
  GROUP BY 1
),
weekly_contrib AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.merged_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.merged_date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name,''), pr.author_name)) AS v
  FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id
  WHERE ppm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR (pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) IN ($developer))) GROUP BY 1
),
prod_deploys AS (
  SELECT pm.project_name, cdc.finished_date
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits cdc
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = cdc.cicd_scope_id AND pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
  WHERE pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND LOWER(cdc.environment) LIKE '%prod%' AND cdc.result = 'SUCCESS' AND $__timeFilter(cdc.finished_date)
),
weekly_defects AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(i.created_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(i.created_date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) AS v
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = bi.board_id AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
  JOIN prod_deploys pd ON pd.project_name = pm.project_name
    AND i.created_date BETWEEN pd.finished_date AND DATE_ADD(pd.finished_date, INTERVAL 14 DAY)
  WHERE pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND (i.type IN ('BUG','INCIDENT') OR LOWER(COALESCE(i.original_type,'')) REGEXP 'bug|defect|incident') AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  GROUP BY 1
),
wk AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) AS d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM wk WHERE DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) < $__timeTo()
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS week FROM wk
),
filled AS (
  SELECT w.week,
    COALESCE(c.v, 0) AS cost, COALESCE(p.v, 0) AS prs, COALESCE(t.v, 0) AS tasks,
    COALESCE(ct.v, 0) AS contrib, COALESCE(d.v, 0) AS defects
  FROM weeks w
  LEFT JOIN weekly_cost c ON c.week = w.week
  LEFT JOIN weekly_prs p ON p.week = w.week
  LEFT JOIN weekly_tasks t ON t.week = w.week
  LEFT JOIN weekly_contrib ct ON ct.week = w.week
  LEFT JOIN weekly_defects d ON d.week = w.week
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT week, cost, prs, tasks, contrib, defects,
    LAG(cost) OVER (ORDER BY week) AS cost_prev,
    LAG(prs) OVER (ORDER BY week) AS prs_prev,
    LAG(tasks) OVER (ORDER BY week) AS tasks_prev,
    LAG(contrib) OVER (ORDER BY week) AS contrib_prev,
    LAG(defects) OVER (ORDER BY week) AS defects_prev
  FROM filled
)
SELECT week AS "Week",
  CONCAT(CONCAT('$', CASE WHEN ABS(cost) >= 1000000000 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT(cost / 1000000000, 1), 'B') WHEN ABS(cost) >= 1000000 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT(cost / 1000000, 1), 'M') WHEN ABS(cost) >= 1000 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT(cost / 1000, 1), 'K') ELSE FORMAT(cost, 2) END),
    CASE
      WHEN cost_prev IS NULL THEN ''
      WHEN cost_prev = 0 AND cost = 0 THEN '        ▬0.0%'
      WHEN cost_prev = 0 THEN '        ▲ new'
      WHEN cost > cost_prev THEN CONCAT('        ▲', ROUND(100.0*(cost-cost_prev)/cost_prev,1), '%')
      WHEN cost < cost_prev THEN CONCAT('        ▼', ROUND(100.0*(cost_prev-cost)/cost_prev,1), '%')
      ELSE '        ▬0.0%'
    END
  ) AS "AI Cost",
  CONCAT(CASE WHEN ABS(prs) >= 1000000000 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT(prs / 1000000000, 1), 'B') WHEN ABS(prs) >= 1000000 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT(prs / 1000000, 1), 'M') WHEN ABS(prs) >= 1000 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT(prs / 1000, 1), 'K') ELSE FORMAT(prs, 0) END,
    CASE
      WHEN prs_prev IS NULL THEN ''
      WHEN prs_prev = 0 AND prs = 0 THEN '        ▬0.0%'
      WHEN prs_prev = 0 THEN '        ▲ new'
      WHEN prs > prs_prev THEN CONCAT('        ▲', ROUND(100.0*(prs-prs_prev)/prs_prev,1), '%')
      WHEN prs < prs_prev THEN CONCAT('        ▼', ROUND(100.0*(prs_prev-prs)/prs_prev,1), '%')
      ELSE '        ▬0.0%'
    END
  ) AS "PRs Merged",
  CONCAT(CASE WHEN ABS(tasks) >= 1000000000 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT(tasks / 1000000000, 1), 'B') WHEN ABS(tasks) >= 1000000 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT(tasks / 1000000, 1), 'M') WHEN ABS(tasks) >= 1000 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT(tasks / 1000, 1), 'K') ELSE FORMAT(tasks, 0) END,
    CASE
      WHEN tasks_prev IS NULL THEN ''
      WHEN tasks_prev = 0 AND tasks = 0 THEN '        ▬0.0%'
      WHEN tasks_prev = 0 THEN '        ▲ new'
      WHEN tasks > tasks_prev THEN CONCAT('        ▲', ROUND(100.0*(tasks-tasks_prev)/tasks_prev,1), '%')
      WHEN tasks < tasks_prev THEN CONCAT('        ▼', ROUND(100.0*(tasks_prev-tasks)/tasks_prev,1), '%')
      ELSE '        ▬0.0%'
    END
  ) AS "Tasks Done",
  CONCAT(CASE WHEN ABS(contrib) >= 1000000000 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT(contrib / 1000000000, 1), 'B') WHEN ABS(contrib) >= 1000000 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT(contrib / 1000000, 1), 'M') WHEN ABS(contrib) >= 1000 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT(contrib / 1000, 1), 'K') ELSE FORMAT(contrib, 0) END,
    CASE
      WHEN contrib_prev IS NULL THEN ''
      WHEN contrib_prev = 0 AND contrib = 0 THEN '        ▬0.0%'
      WHEN contrib_prev = 0 THEN '        ▲ new'
      WHEN contrib > contrib_prev THEN CONCAT('        ▲', ROUND(100.0*(contrib-contrib_prev)/contrib_prev,1), '%')
      WHEN contrib < contrib_prev THEN CONCAT('        ▼', ROUND(100.0*(contrib_prev-contrib)/contrib_prev,1), '%')
      ELSE '        ▬0.0%'
    END
  ) AS "Contributors",
  CONCAT(CASE WHEN ABS(defects) >= 1000000000 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT(defects / 1000000000, 1), 'B') WHEN ABS(defects) >= 1000000 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT(defects / 1000000, 1), 'M') WHEN ABS(defects) >= 1000 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT(defects / 1000, 1), 'K') ELSE FORMAT(defects, 0) END,
    CASE
      WHEN defects_prev IS NULL THEN ''
      WHEN defects_prev = 0 AND defects = 0 THEN '        ▬0.0%'
      WHEN defects_prev = 0 THEN '        ▲ new'
      WHEN defects > defects_prev THEN CONCAT('        ▲', ROUND(100.0*(defects-defects_prev)/defects_prev,1), '%')
      WHEN defects < defects_prev THEN CONCAT('        ▼', ROUND(100.0*(defects_prev-defects)/defects_prev,1), '%')
      ELSE '        ▬0.0%'
    END
  ) AS "Escaped Defects"
FROM lagged
ORDER BY week DESC

panels.title: AI Cost / PRs Merged / Tasks Done / Contributors / Escaped Defects — Weekly, with WoW % Change

panels.description: Compares the raw distinct `accounts.id` count for PR authors against the name-deduplicated count used for the Contributors KPI above, scoped to the selected project(s). The gap between the two is mostly caused by engineers accumulating multiple account rows when their git client reports different emails or hostnames across machines, rather than by genuinely distinct people.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT pr.author_id) AS "Raw Account Count",
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name,''), pr.author_name)) AS "Name-Deduped Count",
  ROUND(100.0 * (COUNT(DISTINCT pr.author_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name,''), pr.author_name))) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT pr.author_id), 0), 1) AS "Overcount %"
FROM project_pr_metrics ppm
JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id
WHERE ppm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR (pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) IN ($developer)))

panels.title: Distinct-Account Sanity Check

panels.description: Count of board-linked issues per selected project created within the selected time range, and how many of them have a normalized `type` of BUG/INCIDENT or an `original_type` containing bug/defect/incident. It reports whether those fields provide any defect classification; it does not inspect labels. `Not classified` means no matching issue was created in the selected range, not that the project has no defects; on short ranges this can happen even for projects that do classify defects. Ignores the Developer filter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT pm.project_name AS "Project",
  SUM((i.type IN ('BUG','INCIDENT') OR LOWER(COALESCE(i.original_type,'')) REGEXP 'bug|defect|incident')) AS "Classified Defects",
  COUNT(*) AS "Total Issues",
  CASE WHEN SUM((i.type IN ('BUG','INCIDENT') OR LOWER(COALESCE(i.original_type,'')) REGEXP 'bug|defect|incident')) > 0 THEN 'Available' ELSE 'Not classified' END AS "Defect-Rate Coverage"
FROM issues i
JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = bi.board_id AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
WHERE pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
GROUP BY pm.project_name
ORDER BY 2 DESC

list.definition:
WITH scoped_conn AS (
  SELECT cp.connection_id
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
  INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
  WHERE c.status = 'active'
    AND cp.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
),
otel AS (
  SELECT user_email AS email FROM ai_activities
  WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity' AND user_email <> '' AND source_connection_id IN (SELECT connection_id FROM scoped_conn) AND $__timeFilter(date)
  UNION
  SELECT user_email FROM ai_model_usages
  WHERE user_email <> '' AND source_connection_id IN (SELECT connection_id FROM scoped_conn) AND $__timeFilter(date)
),
linked AS (
  SELECT o.email, MIN(g.author_id) AS gid
  FROM otel o
  JOIN _tool_github_commits g ON g.author_email = o.email AND g.author_id > 0
  GROUP BY o.email
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT g.author_id) = 1
),
pr_authors AS (
  SELECT CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1) AS UNSIGNED) AS gid, MAX(pr.author_name) AS login
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
  WHERE pm.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND pr.author_name NOT LIKE '%[bot]'
    AND ($__timeFilter(pr.created_date) OR $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) OR $__timeFilter(pr.closed_date))
  GROUP BY 1
),
people AS (
  SELECT CONCAT('gh:', l.gid) AS k, l.gid, MIN(l.email) AS email, NULL AS login, 1 AS has_ai FROM linked l GROUP BY l.gid
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CONCAT('em:', o.email), NULL, o.email, NULL, 1 FROM otel o WHERE o.email NOT IN (SELECT email FROM linked)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CONCAT('gh:', p.gid), p.gid, NULL, p.login, 0 FROM pr_authors p WHERE p.gid NOT IN (SELECT gid FROM linked)
),
named AS (
  SELECT p.k, p.has_ai, COALESCE(ga.login, p.login, p.email) AS handle,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(ga.name, ''), ga.login, p.login, p.email) AS name
  FROM people p
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, MAX(login) AS login, MAX(name) AS name FROM _tool_github_accounts GROUP BY id) ga ON ga.id = p.gid
)
SELECT CONCAT(
    name,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY name) > 1 AND handle <> name THEN CONCAT(' (', handle, ')') ELSE '' END,
    CASE WHEN k LIKE 'em:%' THEN ' · no GitHub link' WHEN has_ai = 0 THEN ' · no AI data' ELSE '' END
  ) AS __text,
  k AS __value
FROM named
ORDER BY has_ai DESC, __text;
